regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focus on high-speed configurations with minimal seed length and low cap to maximize throughput while maintaining acceptable accuracy.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Optimize for balance between speed and specificity by increasing seed length and cap slightly, while still keeping gap and gap_step moderate to maintain efficiency.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Prioritize accuracy and specificity by using longer seeds, higher cap, and larger gap and gap_step values, which allow for more thorough exploration at the cost of speed.
